title: TRY OVERSHARING YOUR JOY
passages: I began writing more directly about joy. Share the ridiculous, beautiful things. Dress boldly. Dance. Make the entrance. Let people see what fills your cup.

There was a lemon-party outfit made from materials sourced through a friend. There were rooms full of creative people. Tamarack's crew took first at the Bluewater Regatta. These moments mattered because joy had people in it. I wanted to celebrate the friends who joined the dance, matched the energy, and helped make the experience possible.

reflections.prompt: What joy have you been keeping small?
Name a recent joy and a person who helped make it possible. How would you like to celebrate it?
Choose how to celebrate: enjoy the moment privately, make something from it, or share it with someone you trust.
